extraRules: All builds, tests, vet, node checks, protocol validation, ISA builds and screenshots run via BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=2 just bb. This overrides generic workflow rules and final-gate examples that permit local ISA builds or unprefixed build2/validate-protocol. Production CGO_ENABLED=0; race checks only CGO_ENABLED=1 CC=/usr/bin/gcc on x-boss. Go -p 2, Node --test-concurrency=2.

No attn, no live changes, no capture or secrets access without a separately authorised operator step. Never read secrets/, *.secret, .data/, env files or ~/.config/vecnet. Never touch dev hub 45752 or preview 49575.
No npm or pnpm install; headless Chromium through scripts/ui/lib.mjs only. Isolated SHOTS_DIR; never open windows.
Never change connectors/**, internal/opseed/**, real fly.toml or real hub credentials/peers/database. Do not deploy to the real app.
Public demo uses a dedicated mux; no httpapi.New or NewStack.Run. Default deny unknown routes/methods. No operator bearer in browser and no implicit UI writes.
Only reviewed actual-session fixtures with digest-bound human approval may launch publicly. Synthetic fixtures are test-only. No automatic export approval or production DB copying.
Optional live feature remains disabled. Only exact configured free models and OpenRouter allowlisted paths; no tools/paid fallback. Durable 40-attempt/day quota and kill state survive resets.

Actual website CTA source, fixture approval, model/data-policy verification, Fly organisation/network/quote and DNS are pending operator gates. Report pending accurately; do not invent live acceptance evidence.

Unconditional code gates use demo-deploy-check --offline and explicit synthetic test paths. Actual approved fixture/network/site-link readiness is a pending publication gate until operator supplied; --public must fail closed without it. Never weaken --public to make the implementation gate green.
Visitor chat content stays in per-session in-memory hub stores, never replay/disk/WAL; access expires at 30 minutes and deadline cleanup by 31 minutes. No production build with CGO enabled.

lensFocus.spec: Check the assignment requirements and ten plan tasks: distinct Fly app/network, anonymous all-view access, real sanitised reviewed capture, time shift/progressive truthfulness, optional free-model replies, costs and fail-closed limits. No live actions are authorised by planning.
lensFocus.security: Attack public mux route/method fallback, DTO leaks, export strings and IDs, arbitrary URLs/redirects/DNS rebinding/browser media, session isolation, CSRF, free-model price changes, budget races/crashes/reset/UTC rollover and retention snapshots. Verify no real network/config/peers shared.
lensFocus.tests: Each named test fails before implementation and proves behaviour; guard normal hub auth. All commands through BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=2 just bb, fakes only, temp roots, no local builds. Browser journey catches hidden writes, remote loads and false live labels.
